items.computation: Letter dated Mon 02.03.2026, sent by ordinary post from an authority: under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG it counts as delivered (bekanntgegeben) on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Fri 06.03.2026. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month period starts the following day; under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB it ends one month later on the same-numbered day, Mon 06.04.2026. That day is Ostermontag (Easter Monday), a public holiday in Baden-Württemberg, so under § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG the deadline shifts to the next business day, Tue 07.04.2026.

warnings: The letter states that a separate Gebührenbescheid (fee decision) for this decision will follow; no amount or due date for that fee is given in this letter and must be checked once it arrives.
